status: Specific prototype selections and process targets; optical/force performance unqualified

notes: No plasticizer is added in this prototype selection.
Use material/cure-compatibility coupons and record actual thickness before a full finger.
The paper used a different XP-565/plasticizer gel; its results do not transfer to Solaris.

coatings.binder: Smooth-On Psycho Paint platinum silicone paint base
coatings.application: Brush/stipple without solvent; manufacturer permits solvent-free brushing
stack_order_from_camera: Black marker dots on its outer surface
notes: Paint a clean platinum-cured surface promptly after demolding, following supplier instructions.
Opacity, pigment dispersion, bond, friction and wear must be accepted physically.
A 0.1 mm overcoat is a prototype process target, not a proven optical or force specification.

illumination.method: Four fixed blue LEDs; use marker/deformation observations rather than claiming a photometric normal map
illumination.capture_channel: Blue channel for the first marker-tracking baseline; preserve full BGR images
notes: Four independent resistor/LED branches; no unresisted parallel LED connection.
No fluorescent side paints or yellow filter are required for this selected marker/deformation baseline.
Actual brightness, uniformity, heating, opacity and contact discrimination remain to be measured.

mirror.material: 0.2 mm reflective PET sheet, on a fixed rigid backing
mirror.supplier_acceptance: Verify thickness, reflective-side orientation, flatness and image sharpness on the actual sheet
